title: Memory Test
summary: A tablet test of visual-spatial memory under load: place objects in rooms, then recall them among distractors.
description:
The memory test assesses visual-spatial memory under load.

1. **Placement** — the patient places objects in rooms of their choice.
2. **Recall** — after a short distraction, they recall the locations while new "distractor" objects appear.
3. **Executive load** — a diary-planning task adds load before a final recall.

## Status
The memory test completed a trial with **more than 50 patients**, including a pilot at Protea in the Village. It is part of the [Digital Cognitive Test Battery](/projects/digital-cognitive-tests).
